slice_contract.problem: M7-D WIP 把 RuntimeEvent v16 降级成 v14 后交给历史 Harness，并按 call_id、ToolOutcome.workspace_revision 与任意后续成功猜测编辑恢复；它还提供没有 treatment delta 的单变体 live/Key 路径，因此不能形成可信 production 失败基线。
acceptance: 只投影 canonical RuntimeEvent v16，不导入或 monkeypatch 历史 M7-A executor
ToolPrepared、ToolExecutionStarted 与 ToolOutcomeCommitted 只按 operation_id 配对，失败必须携带稳定 failure_code
workspace revision 只取 ToolOutcomeCommitted.workspace_state.revision，不把 ToolOutcome.workspace_revision 当 Runtime revision
恢复只在同一 run、同一工具、同一可解析结构化目标且至少经过一个新的 ModelRequestPrepared 后归因；未知 patch header 目标保持 unscorable
side_effect=indeterminate 与 Started 后无 Outcome 分开计数为 transaction ambiguity，不从 normal run 推断 crash 频率
Harness output 名称由 manifest 唯一绑定、0600、maximum_reruns=0 且不可覆盖
CLI status 必须由 aggregate passed 决定；失败 gate 在 0600 ignored record 中保留有界诊断 tail
root、read-only child、explicit Writer、三段工具 crash、app-server SIGKILL、focused、fmt、workspace clippy/test 与 git diff 门禁全部离线通过
没有真实 treatment delta 时不读取 Key、不构建 release binary、不调用官方 API
replaces: 对历史 M7-A executor 的全局 monkeypatch
按 call_id、旧 outcome revision 与任意后续成功进行恢复归因
无 treatment delta 的单变体 live/Key 执行入口
evidence: canonical Rust production loopback、actor conformance 与 process crash/reopen gates
首个 suite 的不可复现 workspace-test 失败记录与新的 v2 一次性 0600 ignored offline record
cutover_deletion: 历史 executor import、v16_as_v14、configure_executor、live、schedule、key read 与 cost acknowledgement
已删除 immutable binary 的 stale identity
任意 eval/results JSON 输出和 replace 写入

observation_contract.source: canonical StoredRuntimeEvent ledger emitted by AgentRuntime and reopened by RunStore

target_identity.unresolved_patch_headers: unscorable; Harness does not copy the production patch parser

observation_contract.recovery: same run + same tool + same target identity + later successful committed outcome + one or more intervening ModelRequestPrepared
transaction_ambiguity: may_write edit ToolExecutionStarted without a committed outcome in the observed ledger

decision_rules.edit_recovery_candidate: edit_recovery reaches both preregistered minimums; unrelated unrecovered failures do not count
decision_rules.transaction_candidate: at least one canonical indeterminate edit side effect or incomplete started write operation
decision_rules.no_mechanism: no bucket reaches its preregistered threshold

admission.reason: 该切片只修复观测可信度；production editor、request surface 与模型行为均无 control/treatment 差异。
